title: Six frontier models trade $10,000 each autonomously in nof1's Alpha Arena
summary: Nof1, an AI research firm, is running a contest called Alpha Arena in which six AI models, each given a starting capital of $10,000, trade cryptocurrency perpetual contracts on the Hyperliquid exchange from 17 October to 3 November 2025 under rules that require each model to generate its own trading ideas, size and time its trades and manage its own risk, with model outputs and trades published. By 20 October, Grok, DeepSeek and Claude Sonnet 4.5 were each up more than 25% while GPT-5, which had placed only a few small trades, had lost more than 28% and Gemini 2.5 Pro had engaged in frequent, erratic trading, switching between bearish and bullish stances at a loss; the article cautions that the rankings are in flux and possibly too preliminary to matter.

actors.model: GPT-5; Claude Sonnet 4.5; Gemini 2.5 Pro; Grok; DeepSeek
